docs.title: Scush Documentation
docs.text:
Welcome to the Scush system documentation.

This site is built with MkDocs and served directly by the Django app, replacing the previous S3-hosted documentation site.

docs.title: Adding a page
docs.text:
1. Add a new Markdown file under docs/.
  2. List it in the nav: section of mkdocs.yml at the repo root.
  3. Rebuild the site:

mkdocs build

  1. Commit the regenerated files in core/static/docs/ along with your Markdown source.
